title: A quand une intégration Apple Watch?
body:
Très bien pensé. 

Mais je ne vais pas renouveler mon abonnement à Sunsama tant il est illogique que le widget Apple Watch - qui permet de ne pas avoir besoin de son téléphone de/ de déconnecter numériquement en conservent juste les alertes essentielles - n’ait pas été développé.
author: Solazet

title: Super daily productivity app
body: I have used Sunsama every day for the last 2-3 years. It has become THE tool I rely on for weekly planning and daily productivity. And I’m looking forward to the thoughtful AI integrations they’re working on. I highly recommend this tool to colleagues and friends as it’s very easy to use and smart.
author: Lucky 2025!

title: It's honestly not good
body:
The app feels very buggy at this state. Sync sometimes does not work and even end up messing up the schedule when you interact too fast or early. It's quite a shame at this price tag, because the potential for a great product is there. 

I ended up with the web version.
author: jeanpaulpollue

title: No notifications
body: Good app but no notifications on due date and due time on my iPhone nor the desktop app.
author: Stelluci

title: A very good fondation
body: The application itself works very well and fully fulfils its role as a comparions to the desktop application. To be even more productivity oriented it would be nice to develop a widget to see tacks as well as a watch intégration
